texts.label: text
texts.orig: ABSTRACT . In this paper , we prove the solvability of the vortex   equation on holomorphic   vector bundle over compact   Hermitian manifold  using the continuity method, and show the Kobayashi-Hitchin   correspondence for holomorphic pairs. This work extends Bradlow's Kobayashi-Hitchin correspondence over comKahler manifolds to compact non-Kahler manifolds. pact
